title: Role-Play Paradox in Large Language Models: Reasoning Performance Gains and Ethical Dilemmas

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice stereotype association tests (StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs) to measure the likelihood of selecting unbiased options when models are assigned personas with specific binary and non-binary gender identities combined with various occupations.

Multiple-choice stereotype association tests (StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs) to evaluate the rate of unbiased responses when models are assigned personas associated with specific racial groups and geographic origins (e.g., Black, White, Asian, From Africa, From Europe, From America).

Multiple-choice stereotype association tests (StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs) to measure the model's propensity to choose unbiased responses while adopting personas of six widely practiced religions (Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, Traditional Chinese Religion, Judaism).
